intro: The China tourist visa (L visa) is for holidays, sightseeing and tours. British passport holders can currently visit China visa-free for short trips, so you need an L visa if your stay is longer, you want multiple entries, or you travel on another passport. We complete your application and book your visa centre appointment.
eligibility: Your trip is for tourism, sightseeing or visiting friends, not work or study
Your passport is valid for at least six months, with two blank visa pages
If you are not British, you hold valid UK residence status
documents: Original passport, plus a copy of the photo page
Recent colour photo on a white background, meeting Chinese visa specifications
Hotel bookings for your whole stay, or an invitation letter if you’re staying with someone in China
Your UK visa or eVisa share code, if you are not British
Copies of any previous Chinese visas

prices.included: Form completion, document check, visa centre appointment and submission support
Everything in Standard, with faster processing at the visa centre
Everything in Standard, with the fastest processing available

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for a holiday in China?
faqs.a: If you travel on a British passport, short holidays are currently visa-free. You need an L visa for longer stays, or if you travel on a passport that isn’t covered. We check the latest rules for your dates and passport before you book.

faqs.q: Do I need to attend the visa centre?
faqs.a: Yes. Most applicants give fingerprints in person at a Chinese Visa Application Service Centre. We book the appointment and prepare everything you take with you.

faqs.q: Can I get a multiple-entry tourist visa?
faqs.a: Often, yes, especially if you have visited China before. Tell us how often you plan to travel and we’ll advise on the best visa to request.
